judgments.reason: The support span 'lacunar infarctions and periventricular white matter hyperintensities (WMH)' appears literally in the MRI Image 1 Description, and these findings clinically support the composite modifier components of lacunar infarctions and periventricular white matter hyperintensities in HTRA1-related cerebral small vessel disease.

The support span 'multiple cerebral microbleeds (CMBs)' appears literally in the SWI Image 2 Description, and cerebral microbleeds are a recognized imaging feature of HTRA1-related hereditary cerebral small vessel disease, clinically supporting this composite modifier component.
